attribution.gages: Streamflow: U.S. Geological Survey, National Water Information System (waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/iv). Public domain; provisional data subject to revision. Sites marked dwr in gage_src are DWR-operated and read from CDSS telemetry (parameter DISCHRG), because NWIS publishes no discharge for them.
attribution.res: Reservoir storage: Colorado Division of Water Resources satellite telemetry, via the CDSS REST services (dwr.state.co.us/Rest). CDSS is developed by the Colorado Water Conservation Board and DWR. Provisional data subject to revision.
attribution.note: Collated once daily by github.com/jimmylowell/colorado_water for water.myjimmycloud.com. Educational, not operational data — verify against the primary sources before relying on any value.

units.res.sto: acre-feet, latest telemetered storage (asOf = reading date)
units.delta: cfs equivalent of the past week’s storage trend; positive = drawing down (1 acre-foot/day ≈ 0.50417 cfs)
